description: GET ONLY the 'Advertising' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Advertising — logical ad Placements (rewarded video, interstitial, banner, app-open), the mediation Providers that serve them (AppLovin MAX, LevelPlay, ...) with per-platform app IDs and ad unit IDs, per-format settings, frequency capping, premium ad-removal perks, GDPR/ATT consent policy, rewarded-video server-side verification (SSV) and the daily revenue import from the provider's Reporting API. Shared secrets (SSV keys, report keys) are NOT stored here — only the NAME of the TitleSecrets entry that holds them.
name: get_advertising
title: Get Advertising settings
